description: Update one SMS number's settings: the user-facing label, its brand prefix override, and/or link shortening. Use get_sms_settings to find the number ID. Omitted fields keep their value; pass an empty string to clear label or brandPrefix. Requires workspace-management permission.

brandPrefix.description: Per-number brand prefix override up to 100 characters; messages go out as "{prefix}: your message". Pass an empty string to clear it back to the account-wide prefix.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

label.description: Label up to 100 characters, such as Marketing or Support. Pass an empty string to clear it.

linkShorteningEnabled.description: true (the default) replaces links in messages from this number with click-tracked short links; false sends links exactly as written, for example the customer's own tracking links, and SMS clicks from this number are then not tracked. Long links can add segments, which uses more credits, so tell the user before turning it off. Applies to messages prepared after the change.

numberId.description: SMS number ID returned by get_sms_settings.

name: update_sms_number_label

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `update_sms_number_label` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

number.description: The updated SMS number (label, brandPrefix override, linkShorteningEnabled) record returned by Sequenzy.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
